subject: Follow-up: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Procurement path & PR guidance (Coupa/Ariba) for Acme Corp

Hi Samantha / Tom 

Great to speak with you earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the agreed next steps on procurement and commercial path so your team can raise the PR and speed up onboarding: 

1) Commercial path options we discussed
   - Preferred: Purchase Order (PO) via Coupa/Ariba (typical for enterprise)
   - Alternative: Corporate card for pilot/PO-less purchases (smaller initial purchase)
   - Marketplace: We can also transact via AWS Marketplace if your procurement prefers a marketplace purchase (pricing and terms vary).

2) Action items for Acme (please confirm):
   - Confirm whether procurement will issue a PO via Coupa or Ariba (and which supplier ID they will use).
   - If supplier is not in your system, create a PR to onboard Redwood as a new supplier and link to the supplier creation request below.
   - Fill out the attached PR_template.xlsx with GL code and billing contact and attach to the PR.

3) What Redwood will provide
   - Sample PR description and required fields (attached: sample_pr_lines.txt).
   - Supplier details: "Redwood Inference, Inc."; billing address and tax details in the template; our preferred remit to instructions once supplier is created.
   - We will create an internal ticket with our finance team to expedite supplier creation if needed (FIN-4321) and share the supplier ID back to you.

Attachments: PR_template.xlsx, Coupa_supplier_sheet.csv, sample_pr_lines.txt

If you prefer, I can loop in our procurement ops (Lauren Bishop) and finance (Neha Kapoor) on the thread to accelerate the supplier onboarding. Please let me know the path (Coupa vs Ariba vs Marketplace) and an estimate for when you’ll raise the PR.

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi Samantha —

We accept supplier onboarding via either Coupa or Ariba. Quick notes that may help your procurement team: 

- Required supplier fields (common): Legal name: "Redwood Inference, Inc."; Address: 123 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94107; Tax ID: 12-3456789 (placeholder; we will provide full EIN in the vendor form).
- Remittance / invoicing contact: billing@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement guidance: Step-by-step PR & supplier linkage (Coupa/Ariba)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks — below is a concise, step-by-step guide your procurement team can paste into Coupa or Ariba when creating the PR and/or supplier onboarding request. I’ve also included the exact language we typically ask to appear on the PR to speed approvals.

Step A — Supplier onboarding (if Redwood not present)
  1) Create vendor/supplier record in Coupa or Ariba. Required fields we typically see: 
     - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
     - Address: 123 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94107
     - Tax ID/EIN: (we will provide upon vendor form submission)
     - Remit to email: billing@redwood.com
     - Primary contact: Marissa Cole, marissa@redwood.com, +1 415-555-0142
  2) If your system requires a supplier ID, please share that ID back to us so we can populate the HubSpot record (example: SUP-XXXX-123).

Step B — PR creation (what to include in the line item)
  - Item description: Redwood Inference — Inference platform services (monthly committed capacity)
  - Quantity/term: 1 x 12 months (or pilot: 1 x 1 month)
  - Unit price: [use negotiated rate on HubSpot deal RDW-2026-ACME-07]
  - GL code: [insert your GL code]
  - Billing contact: accounts.payable@acme.com
  - PO reference: RDW-2026-ACME-07

Suggested PR justification text (copy/paste):
  "Purchase of Redwood Inference LLM inference platform for product feature rollout. One-year subscription with optional pilot month. Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc. PO to be sent to billing@redwood.com. See HubSpot deal RDW-2026-ACME-07 for negotiated pricing and SOW details."

Marketplace option: If procurement prefers AWS Marketplace, please indicate on the PR that purchase will be via AWS Marketplace and include marketplace AMI/ID. We can provide marketplace ordering codes. Note that invoicing and term details differ for marketplace purchases.

Internal ticket & timeline: We created internal finance ticket FIN-4321 to track supplier onboarding / payment terms from our side. If you create the supplier in Coupa/Ariba, please reply to this thread with the supplier ID and a copy of the PR so we can link it on our side and generate the invoice.

Attachments included again: PR_template.xlsx, Coupa_supplier_sheet.csv, sample_pr_lines.txt

Happy to jump on a 15-minute handoff call with your procurement lead if that would be helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
